envelope.description: JetBrains: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action in the repo settings

body.title: JetBrains: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action in the repo settings
body.summary: In jetbrains-plugin add buildSetup to RepoSettingsDto (parsed in DaemonGateway.kt) and render the Build rows as a section of their own in RepoTrackerModel's settings view, with the suggestion as the placeholder and the same 'use suggested' write with the clear-the-first rollback. Its Kotlin tests cannot be run here: the Task is verified by reading and by the user's Gradle run, and its smoke-level test is reported by the builder with evidence, not claimed as run.
acceptanceChecks: RepoSettingsDto carries an optional buildSetup and a payload without it parses as before
The repo settings view lists the Build rows as a section of their own with the suggestion as the placeholder
The 'use suggested' action is offered only when commands source is 'none' and a suggestion exists, writes only when invoked and clears the first key if the second write fails
The Kotlin contract test is updated and reported as not run here, with where the evidence is

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/RepoFieldsContractTest.kt: the JetBrains repo settings render the Build rows as a section of their own
